In this lecture you understand mortuary evidence and research limits.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. The lecture can be given online or at your venue, for a single class, a department or a whole organisation.

What it covers

  • Burial context
  • Bioarchaeology
  • Ethics

How the time is spent

  1. Burial context 20 min

    Context recording, taphonomy and burial patterns.

    You: plan reading

  2. Bioarchaeology 45 min

    Osteology, isotopes and disease studies.

    You: methods matching

  3. Ethics 25 min

    Human remains dignity, sampling uncertainty.

    You: decision note

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.
